note: The owner's rules in force for the XAUUSD advisory system, each with its source. Changed only by a reviewed PR in this repository.

rules.rule: Advisory only: no broker integration, no orders, no automatic execution and no position size.
Reports to the platform kernel never carry price levels (entry, stop, target, zones, key levels).
BUY needs a confirmed buy signal (the H1 Prophet R38 confirmation, or a verified 5m Prophet R38 confirmation candle); SELL needs a confirmed sell. Without it the stance is WAIT.
Every opening states its action and its bias (BULLISH, BEARISH or NEUTRAL): the direction its own data leans, even when the action is WAIT.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, Bias beside the action

rules.rule: A BUY or SELL conclusion needs at least one agent holding that stance; a BULLISH or BEARISH bias needs at least one agent holding it.

Agents never mention calibration, parity or verification in their text; readers see each agent's calibration status once, next to its name. An agent with no calibrated statement speaks at confidence 0.4 or lower.
Each HUD or indicator agent analyses only the data its own HUD or indicator produces.
Without valid, verified evidence the H1 decision is WAIT, never a guess.
Local engine trust comes only from the parity registry (24 consecutive matching candles); nothing is marked verified by hand, and the Pine sources and hashed engines are never edited.

No change to an engine parameter, a prompt or a knowledge item is promoted automatically: candidates run in shadow, are judged by outcome scoring with a significance test, and the owner approves a separate promotion PR.
Learned knowledge is labelled as learned, cites its evidence, and never redefines a field or a rule of the canon.
Calls to the platform kernel use RPC Service Bindings without shared secrets; reports are info or warning, never critical; a denial is final (no retry, no switching agent ids).
